items.title: Capim Grosso (BA) Health & medical procurement · government procurement procedure · closes Dec 2 #037
items.en_title: Capim Grosso (BA) Health & medical procurement · government procurement procedure · closes Dec 2 #037
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Capim Grosso (BA) is procuring healthcare goods or services through government procurement procedure, with an estimated value of about R$ 24,600; proposals close Dec 2, 08:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
